standard_prerequisites.name: Pushforward of a quasi-coherent sheaf along the canonical morphism from the spectrum of a local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Schemes, label schemes-lemma-push-forward-quasi-coherent, invoked at proof line 174
standard_prerequisites.use: It shows that $\mathcal{F} = (\Spec(\mathcal{O}_{T,t}) \to T)_*\widetilde M$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf on $T$, so that the affine form of the criterion can be applied to it.

standard_prerequisites.name: The affine form of the criterion for an etale ring map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, label lemma-etale-flat-up-down, invoked at proof line 179
standard_prerequisites.use: Applied to the sheaf whose stalk at $t$ is $M$, it gives the equivalence of flatness over $\mathcal{O}_{S,s}$ and over $\mathcal{O}_{T,t}$.

core_obligations: Reduce to the case where $S$ and $T$ are affine, replacing them by affine neighbourhoods of $s$ and of $t$ (proof lines 171-172).
Form the quasi-coherent sheaf on $T$ obtained by pushing forward the module viewed over the local ring of $t$, whose stalk at $t$ is $M$ (proof lines 173-177).
Apply the affine criterion for an etale ring map to conclude the equivalence of the two flatness conditions (proof lines 178-179).
proof_roadmap: The sheaf with stalk $M$ at $t$ (proof lines 173-177).
Application of the affine criterion (proof lines 178-179).
difficulty_reason: The lemma transfers flatness across an etale morphism at the level of local rings: for a module over the local ring of a point of the cover, flatness over the base local ring and over the local ring of the cover are equivalent (statement lines 159-168, tag 05BA). The proof reduces to affine neighbourhoods, realizes the module as the stalk at $t$ of a quasi-coherent sheaf pushed forward from the spectrum of the local ring, and applies the affine form of the criterion. The reduction and the transport of the module are the substance, so the claim is H2.
